versionwatch-desc: Checks MediaWiki, PHP, the database server, extensions and skins for available updates
versionwatch-note-bad-response: $1 returned a response that could not be read.
versionwatch-note-unknown-product: No release information is available for this software.
versionwatch-note-supported-until: This release branch is supported until $1.
versionwatch-note-eol-passed: Support for this release branch ended on $1.
versionwatch-note-eol: This release branch is no longer supported.
versionwatch-note-only-ignored-commits: Behind only by {{PLURAL:$1|one commit|$1 commits}} from ignored authors, such as translation updates.
versionwatch-note-no-branch: The upstream repository has no $1 branch. The extension may be unmaintained, or use a different branch; you can set one in $wgVersionWatchRepositories.
versionwatch-note-repo-not-found: Repository $1 was not found on $2. Set where it lives in $wgVersionWatchRepositories, or set it to false to skip it.
versionwatch-note-commit-not-found: The installed commit $1 does not exist upstream. This may be a fork or a local change.
versionwatch-note-no-version: Not installed from git and declares no version. If it came with the MediaWiki download, it is updated together with MediaWiki.
versionwatch-note-no-upstream-version: The upstream branch declares no version to compare with.
versionwatch-note-github-rate-limit: The GitHub rate limit was reached. Set $wgVersionWatchGitHubToken to raise it.
